name: P01_liquid_gold
motion_prompt: Locked-off camera. Broad champagne-gold liquid-metal folds slowly undulate like heavy silk in a gentle breeze. Highlights glide continuously across the curved reflective surfaces. The motion completes a slow breathing cycle and returns to the starting composition. Deep charcoal center stays open and dark. Elegant restrained motion, physically coherent material, seamless-looking ambient stage background, no camera movement, no cuts.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
